description: Build neumorphic (soft-UI) styles: light or dark mode, shadow distance and intensity, with a live preview and copyable box-shadow CSS.

faqs.a: It works on the element you apply it to; the generator previews it on both a raised card and a pressed-in button so you can see both states.
faqs.q: Does it style my whole page?

faqs.a: Pick "Pressed" from the shadow mode to invert the shadows, which reads as an indented button.
faqs.q: How do I make an indented/pressed button?

faqs.a: Neumorphism relies on subtle light and dark shadows — pick a mid-tone background color for the effect to read clearly.

howto: Pick light or dark mode and a background color.
Set the shadow distance, blur and intensity.
Preview both card and button live, then copy the CSS.
title: Neumorphism Generator
